behavior.arguments: rdi = pointer to the struct holding the index field at +0x14; rsi = source struct pointer; edx = signed 32-bit index; ecx = signed 32-bit subtrahend for the cursor path; r8b = enable byte.

edges.clamped_offset: edx = edx - ecx + 1, edi = cursor - base - 1, edx = min(edx, edi); edx > 0 returns byte [base + edx], else byte [base].
edges.enable_zero: r8b == 0 returns 0 without reading any struct field.
edges.index_over: sentinel byte not 0xff and edi = [rdi + 0x14] - 1 <= edx (signed) returns 0.
edges.sentinel_bypass: byte [rsi + 0x154] == 0xff skips the range check and goes straight to the cursor path.
edges.zero_index: edx == 0 on the cursor path returns byte [base] without the subtract/clamp steps.

behavior.entry_shape: Opens with endbr64; five forward conditional branches (je, je, jle, je, je) plus cmovg clamping; a 9-byte nopw between the main ret and the cursor-base fallback block is intra-body alignment padding; two rets; no calls inside.
behavior.return_rule: Returns one byte in eax on every path: 0, the sentinel-bypassed range result, byte [base + clamped offset], byte [base], or byte [rsi + 0x153]. No field is written anywhere.

coordinate_system: ELF virtual addresses, without a guessed loader or Ghidra rebase. The ELF section table maps .text with file offset = VA - 0x1000; the retained .eh_frame has equal file offset and VA. The tools resolve sections rather than assuming one global VA/file-offset relationship.

incoming_pattern_scan.note: Byte-pattern scan over the full .text section (70,370,352 bytes) for e8 sites whose rel32 lands on the window start; nine sites found in eight distinct caller FDEs, each confirmed as an instruction start by linear disassembly from its caller FDE start. This is explicitly not a complete xref census: indirect calls, tail jumps, and PLT references are out of scope for the scan.
incoming_pattern_scan.relocation_note: No relocation record of any type in any .rela.* section names this window as addend (full-section scan: 80,022 .rela.dyn + 278 .rela.plt entries).
